extension.summary: Widgets and lists from your self-hosted Floppy tracker
extension.description: Browse your Floppy (self-hosted media tracker) library from Kodi: Continue Watching, Next Up, Top Picks, Trending, watchlists, history, calendar and your own lists. Every category can be used as a skin widget. Items play through TMDb Helper or any player add-on you configure, and resume positions are saved back to Floppy.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a running Floppy instance and its API token (Settings, Integrations, API Token).
extension.news: 1.2.0: Faster widgets: cached lists show straight away while the service refreshes them in the background, missing artwork no longer holds widgets up, and each widget does less work; widgets reload only when what they show has changed; Kodi no longer has to kill the service to quit.
